---

DECISION: Stripe subscription with 3-day free trial, $3/month after.
PLANS:
- 'free': 1 identification total (not per month)
- 'trial': 3-day Stripe trial, 500/month, starts charging after
- 'active': paying subscriber, 500/month
IMPLEMENTATION:
- lib/usage.ts — checks and increments monthly counter, auto-resets each month
- lib/stripe.ts — lazy singleton (guards against empty env vars)
- /api/stripe/checkout — creates Checkout session with 3-day trial
- /api/stripe/portal — customer billing portal
- /api/webhook/stripe — handles subscription.created/updated/deleted
- /api/identify — gates behind usage, returns { needsUpgrade: true } when over limit
TO ACTIVATE: Set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_PRICE_ID, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in .env.local
PRICE ID: Create a $3/month recurring product in Stripe Dashboard
